d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.
We're looking for an HR Specialist to be the go-to partner for our employees throughout their journey at Calo.

From welcoming new team members and ensuring a seamless onboarding experience to supporting employee relations, resolving workplace challenges, and driving smooth HR operations, you'll play a key role in creating an environment where people can do their best work.
This role is perfect for someone who enjoys being close to the business, loves helping people, and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves to solve problems and improve processes.
q: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Relations, or a similar people-focused role.
Strong knowledge of Saudi Labour Law.
Outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust across all levels of the organization.
Strong problem-solving skills and confidence in handling employee challenges with professionalism and empathy.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Highly organized with excellent time management skills.
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
A proactive mindset with a genuine passion for creating great employee experiences.
r: Own the complete pre-boarding and onboarding journey, including employment contracts, visa coordination, documentation, and orientation.
Be the first point of contact for employees, providing support and guidance on HR-related matters.
Build trusted relationships with employees and managers across the business.
Handle employee relations matters professionally and fairly, including workplace concerns, disciplinary cases, and conflict resolution.
Support managers with day-to-day people operations and workforce planning.
Ensure compliance with Saudi Labour Law and internal HR policies.
Coordinate HR documentation and maintain accurate employee records.
Support payroll by ensuring all employee data and required documentation are accurate and submitted on time.
Promote employee engagement initiatives and help create a positive workplace culture.
Support health, safety, and employee wellbeing initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and contribute to building scalable people operations.
Take ownership of HR projects and operational tasks from start to finish.
Love working with people and helping them succeed.
Stay calm under pressure and enjoy solving complex challenges.
Naturally take ownership and follow through until things are done.
Enjoy balancing operational excellence with a human touch.
Like improving processes instead of simply maintaining them.
Believe that culture is built through everyday actions, not just initiatives.

d: To lead and manage the company's real estate operations, including branch locations, property management, lease negotiations, and expansion projects. The role is responsible for developing and executing real estate strategies that support the company's retail growth, securing prime locations, optimizing occupancy costs, and ensuring the efficient management of the company's property portfolio.
q: Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
8–12 years of relevant experience in real estate management, preferably within the retail sector.
Proven experience managing large retail property portfolios and multiple branches.
Strong experience in retail expansion, site selection, and lease negotiations.
Solid understanding of the Saudi real estate and retail markets.
Experience dealing with shopping malls, commercial centers, landlords, and property developers.
Strong financial analysis, negotiation, and leadership skills.
r: Develop and implement real estate strategies aligned with the company's business expansion plans.
Identify and evaluate new locations for retail branches based on market potential, customer demographics, and business requirements.
Lead site selection, feasibility studies, and location assessments for new branches.
Support the company's expansion plans by identifying strategic retail opportunities.
Lead lease negotiations with landlords, shopping malls, and property owners.
Review and manage rental agreements, renewals, and contract terms.
Ensure favorable lease conditions and optimize rental costs.
Monitor lease expirations, renewals, and contractual obligations.
Oversee the company's real estate portfolio and retail branch locations.
Monitor property performance, occupancy costs, and rental expenses.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure branches meet operational requirements.
Manage property-related issues and ensure timely resolution.
Conduct market research to identify potential expansion opportunities.
Prepare financial feasibility studies and investment evaluations for new locations.
Analyze rental costs, return on investment, and location performance.
Develop budgets and monitor real estate-related expenditures.
Build and maintain strong relationships with landlords, developers, brokers, and relevant authorities.
Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Operations, and Expansion teams.
Lead and develop the real estate team.
Prepare periodic reports and recommendations for senior management.
